title: In decodeWapPdu of WapPushOverSms.java, there is a possible out of bounds read due to an integer… (CVE-2026-58882)
description: A vulnerability in the decodeWapPdu function of WapPushOverSms.java allows a possible out of bounds read caused by an integer overflow. This flaw can be exploited remotely to cause a denial of service without requiring user interaction or additional privileges.
